title: What If Disney's Real Money Isn't Movies?
description:

scenes.narration: What if Disney's biggest money maker isn't a movie at all?
It's the parks. In fiscal 2025, parks, cruises and products earned a record 10 billion dollars.
That's about 57 percent of the operating income from all of Disney's businesses.
One trip pays four ways: tickets, hotels, food and merch.
The movies make you love the characters. The parks are where you pay to meet them.
